scenarios.task: Erect structural steel columns and beams for the new therapy lab wing beside San Francisco Bay mudflats.
hazards: Mud and unstable shoring near slough edge
steps: Attend pre-task huddle and confirm lift plan
Inspect connections, bolts and pins before the pick
Signal crane operator using standard hand signals
Connect beam at elevation with 100% tie-off
Plumb and align column, torque bolts to spec
Secure temporary bracing before releasing the load
Complete fall-protection anchor inspection at shift end

rubric.pass_if: Maintains 100% tie-off at heights above 6 feet
Verifies taglines and rigging before signaling the pick
Uses correct hand signals and halts work on wind gusts

scenarios.robot_role: Carries connectors, pins and bolts up staging routes and scans mudflat-adjacent shoring for settlement.

scenarios.task: Pull and terminate feeder circuits for the governance hall AV and vote-tallying equipment rooms.
steps: Verify lockout/tagout on the panel feeding the circuit
Confirm zero energy with a tested meter
Pull conductors with proper lubricant and bend radius
Terminate per drawing at the panel and j-box
Megger test the run before re-energizing
Label per arc-flash study and restore power under permit

rubric.pass_if: Applies and verifies lockout/tagout before any conductor work
Proves zero energy and performs insulation resistance test
Terminations torqued, labeled and match as-builts

scenarios.robot_role: Repetitive wire prep and label application at bench, keeping the apprentice away from panel live work.

scenarios.task: Install purified water and lab gas piping for molecular modeling lab benches.
steps: Confirm lab shutdown and hot work permit
Hang and support pipe runs per isometric drawing
Fit and weld joints; purge stainless lines with argon
Pressure test with nitrogen to drawing spec
Flush and passivate the purified water loop
Document weld map and test results

rubric.pass_if: Hot work permit secured before any welding
Holds nitrogen test with zero leaks at specified pressure
Maintains purge and passivation records for weld map

scenarios.robot_role: Holds and rotates pipe sections for tack welds under fitter supervision.

scenarios.task: Assemble overhead cable tray racks in the blockchain node room ahead of electricians' wire pull.
steps: Stage materials and keep aisles clear
Locate ceiling structure with the layout drawing
Drill anchors with vacuum dust control
Bolt tray hangers level and torqued
Set tray sections with snap-in splice plates
House-keep and sweep the room

rubric.pass_if: Hangers plumb, level and matching the tray drawing
Uses vacuum extraction or water during drilling
Floor clear of trip hazards at shift end

scenarios.robot_role: Ferries tray sections and anchors from laydown to the work area.

scenarios.task: Fabricate and hang sealed ductwork for the data exchange room requiring tight humidity control.
steps: Lay out duct sections from shop drawings
Fabricate with lock-former and Pittsburgh seam
Apply gaskets and seal all transverse joints
Hang duct from seismic-rated supports
Leak-test ductwork before insulation
Coordinate with insulators for wrap

rubric.pass_if: All joints gasketed or sealed with no visible leaks
Handles sheet metal with gloves and guards in place
Hangers meet seismic bracing spec

scenarios.task: Build and strip formwork for the governance hall elevated lobby slab.
steps: Lay out form lines from surveyor marks
Build edge forms with straight and strongbacks
Install ties, kickers and reshores
Check elevation and plumb before the pour
Monitor forms during concrete placement
Strip forms on schedule after cure and reshore

rubric.pass_if: Forms plumb and to line within tolerance
Reshores installed per shoring plan
No one stands under forms during placement

scenarios.task: Operate a mobile crane to set curtainwall unitized panels on the bay-facing facade.
hazards: Wind gusts off San Francisco Bay
steps: Review lift plan and panel weights
Set crane on mats and verify level and load chart
Complete pre-op inspection and set barricades
Coordinate with riggers on tag lines
Lift, rotate and set panel at guided landing
Confirm release only on rigger signal
Log the pick in the crane record

rubric.pass_if: Performs full pre-operation inspection and documents it
Halts the pick when gusts exceed plan limits
Follows the designated signal person exclusively

scenarios.robot_role: Shuttles rigging gear and panel spacers across the barricaded lift zone.

scenarios.task: Confined-space entry to clean the data exchange room coolant sump after a glycol leak.
ppe: Full-face respirator with organic vapor cartridges
steps: Obtain confined space entry permit and isolate sources
Test atmosphere top to bottom for O2, LEL and vapors
Set up attendant, tripod and retrieval winch
Enter with continuous gas monitoring
Pump out liquid and decontaminate surfaces
Exit and log readings and waste disposal

rubric.pass_if: Entry permit issued and atmosphere tested before entry
Attendant maintains contact and retrieval line throughout
All liquid containerized and manifested per hazwaste rules

scenarios.robot_role: Pre-entry atmospheric survey and visual inspection of the sump interior.
